prompt: Who broke the short course world record in women's 400m freestyle at the youngest age from 2010 to now?
answer: Wang Jianjiahe broke the women’s 400m freestyle short-course world record at the youngest age during this period. She was 16 when she set the record in 2018, with a time of 3:53.97.
